fields.title: Facebook Marketplace listing record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one listing per row. One LISTING row per listing, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows when a query returns nothing. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query this record came from, as '<city> / <category>' or '<city> / search:<term>'.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: feed_unavailable, listing_unavailable or unexpected_error.

listingUrl.title: Listing URL
listingUrl.description: Direct link to the Marketplace item.

title.title: Title
title.description: The listing title as Facebook renders it.

customTitle.title: Seller's title
customTitle.description: The title the seller typed, where it differs from the rendered one.

priceAmount.title: Price
priceAmount.description: Numeric price, for sorting and filtering.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code. Published on the listing page only, so it requires 'Also open each listing page'.

city.title: City
city.description: City the listing is posted in.

state.title: State / region
state.description: State or region, where Facebook publishes one.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Detail pages only. Facebook publishes an approximate point, not the seller's address.

createdAtIso.title: Listed at
createdAtIso.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the listing was created.

ageDays.title: Age (days)
ageDays.description: How long the listing has been up.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: NEW / USED / and similar. Detail pages only.

description.title: Description
description.description: The seller's description. Detail pages only - the feed carries none at all.

sellerName.title: Seller name
sellerName.description: Always null on a logged-out request: Facebook withholds the seller's identity from signed-out visitors, on both the feed and the listing page. Reported as null rather than omitted so the absence is visible.

sellerId.title: Seller ID
sellerId.description: Always null on a logged-out request, for the same reason as sellerName.

subtitles.title: Attributes
subtitles.description: Facebook's free-text attribute line, e.g. ['50K miles'] or ['3 beds', '2 bathrooms'].

vehicleMileage.title: Mileage
vehicleMileage.description: Parsed from the attribute line, which is the only place the feed publishes it.

bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Parsed from the attribute line on property listings.

bathrooms.title: Bathrooms
bathrooms.description: Parsed from the attribute line on property listings.

isSold.title: Sold
isSold.description: Whether Facebook marks the listing as sold.

photoUrl.title: Photo URL
photoUrl.description: Primary listing photo. A signed CDN link that expires.

queryCity.title: Query city
queryCity.description: The city slug this row was found under.

querySearch.title: Query search
querySearch.description: The search term this row was found with, if any.

searchUrl.title: Search URL
searchUrl.description: The Marketplace URL this row came from - open it to see the same results in a browser.

overview.title: Listings
overview.description: One row per listing: what, how much, where and how old.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Vehicle-specific columns for car and motorcycle listings.

property.title: Property
property.description: Bedrooms, bathrooms and location for property listings.

detail.title: With descriptions
detail.description: The fields that only exist on the listing page.
